text: DSH Vision 是面向 Web 客户端的图像识别插件：它在输入框上方加入视觉识别面板，接收粘贴的图片并由主机端调用 GLM-4V，将识别文字作为上下文交给当前会话。用户可以配置模型和 API Key，查看识别状态；插件也会把图片作为附件保存在会话历史中。适合需要让 DSH 理解截图、照片或图片文字的用户。需要配置 Zhipu API Key，并使用其视觉识别服务。

DSH Vision adds image recognition to DSH web. Its composer dock captures pasted images, and the host calls GLM-4V to provide recognition text as conversation context. Users can configure models and an API key, check status, and keep image attachments in session history. Requires a Zhipu API key.

DSH Vision 的功能「粘贴图片识别」：在 Web 输入框粘贴图片并发送后，插件将图片交给主机端识别，再把识别结果作为当前会话上下文提交。
DSH Vision 的功能「模型与密钥设置」：输入框上方的视觉识别面板可添加、选择或删除模型配置并填写 API Key，主机端保存配置并显示当前模型状态。
DSH Vision 使用前须知：粘贴图片会发送到 open.bigmodel.cn 的 GLM 视觉接口进行识别，调用使用所选模型及图片内容。（见 src/index.ts:68-69,254-271）
DSH Vision 使用前须知：API Key 保存在 $DSH_HOME/vision-config.json，以未加密 JSON 写入；默认位置为 ~/.dsh。（见 src/index.ts:117-122,139,175-179）

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · @uachar/dsh-vision-plugin：Vision recognition plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**: paste images into the Web composer, recognize them via **GLM-4V** on the host side, and inject the result into the conversation as a hidden context message. A native dual-face (host + browser) plugin installed as a standalone package.

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · Features：- **Paste & send images** — one or more images pasted into the composer are forwarded to the host for recognition.
- **GLM-4V recognition** — the host calls Zhipu GLM-4V and appends the result as a hidden context user message, so the main model answers based on what the image actually shows.
- **Visible thumbnails** — recognized images are stored as durable attachments and rendered as thumbnails in history.
- **Model / API key settings** — a dock above the composer lets you add models (default `glm-4v-flash`) and API keys; persisted to `$DSH_HOME/vision-config.json`.
- **Self-healing dsh patch** — on load, the host half checks the dsh checkout for the attachment-authorization patch and applies it automatically (idempotent one-line change + apiproxy rebuild).

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · How to use：> Model entries and API keys persist to a plain local JSON file, `$DSH_HOME/vision-config.json` (default `~/.dsh/vision-config.json`): auto-created empty on first load, rewritten on every config change, re-read on restart. The file is local-only, unencrypted, not tracked by git, and removed automatically when the plugin is uninstalled through the manager panel.
@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · Installation & removal：> Requires a working `dsh` CLI (pnpm) and a profile, e.g. `web`.

section: Install from the GitHub release tarball

text:
@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · Build & install from source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/uAcharGG/dsh-vision.git
cd dsh-vision
pnpm install

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · host half:：node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
node node_modules/tsdown/dist/run.mjs --config tsdown.config.ts
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this checkout>
```

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · host half:：> The client bundle (`lib/client.js`) and the typert-generated faces (`lib/typert.host.js` / `lib/typert.remote-client.js`) are build-time artifacts produced by the dsh workspace build; the checked-in `tsconfig.client.json` still references the dsh checkout. To rebuild the client half outside the workspace, migrate that config and the typert generation step first.
@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · host half:：Restart `dsh` after any install to take effect. The browser half is discovered automatically through the package's `dsh.client` declaration.

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · Removal：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @uachar/dsh-vision-plugin
```

Then restart `dsh`. (Uninstalling through the manager panel also deletes `$DSH_HOME/vision-config.json`.)

@uachar/dsh-vision-plugin README · Project structure：| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | host half: `VisionService extends TypertRemoteService` — `@Remote` `queue`/`config`/`status` + `agent/pre-step` & `llm/stream` listeners + GLM call |
| `src/client/index.ts` | browser half: `conversation.input.dock` slot — paste capture, submit interception, model/API-key settings menu |
| `src/patch.ts` + `scripts/apply-dsh-patch.mjs` | self-healing dsh attachment-authorization patch |
| `src/types.ts` | cross-face wire types (lossless JSON) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle composition layer |
| `lib/` | build output (published) |
